breaks.quote: He tried out his opening line on his morning customers. Before December, he was confident.
breaks.why: The change from avoiding the stage to confidence is given with no steps between, so the reader must guess how a rehearsal produced it.

breaks.quote: he came to me with a deadline: the December meeting, in his own voice.
breaks.why: The deadline is named but nothing shows what is at risk if he misses it, so the beat stays weak and the reader has no reason to feel the stakes.
The reader gets no bridge from a customer trial to confidence, so the change is stated and not shown.

breaks.quote: he sent his assistant to present for him, even in his own boardroom
breaks.why: Why a cafe owner avoided speaking, and what the December meeting or his opening line was, is never given, so the reader must guess.
